title: Sonic.EXE Laugh
blurb: A distorted cackle from a hedgehog who should not be capable of one. Sonic.EXE began as a 2011 creepypasta about a cursed game disc and became the defining artefact of haunted-cartridge horror, a genre that only really works if you were young enough to half-believe it. The laugh carries that specific early-YouTube charge: badly compressed, obviously fake, still unpleasant. Use it for corrupted-character bits, fake-out scares, and edits where something cheerful turns sinister. Kept alive by every Friday Night Funkin' mod and horror retrospective since.
origin: From the Sonic.EXE creepypasta and its game adaptations.
